name: OdfcAttachedVHDSDDL
description:
SDDL string representing the ACLs to use when attaching the VHD.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\AttachVHDSDDL
Type:  REG_SZ

name: OdfcVHDAccessMode
description:
Controls whether the VHD/X file should be accessed directly or whether a difference disk should be used. The default is Direct Access (0) which is the same as "Not Configured".

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\VHDAccessMode
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Direct Access, 1 = DiffDisk on Network, 2 = Local DiffDisk, 3 = Unique Disk per Session

name: OdfcVolumeWaitTimemilliseconds
description:
Specifies the number of milliseconds to wait for the volume to be attached by the system. The default is 20000 (20 sec) which is the same as "Not Configured".

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\VolumeWaitTimeMS
Type:  DWORD
Values:  Min = 1000, Max = 1000000

name: OdfcLockedRetryInterval
description:
Specifies the number of seconds to wait between retries. The default value is 5 seconds which is the same as "Not Configured".

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\LockedRetryInterval
Type:  DWORD
Values:  Min = 0, Max = 600

name: OdfcPreventLoginWithTempProfile
description:
Prevent user login when a user receives a temporary Windows profile.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\PreventLoginWithTempProfile
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

name: OdfcIncludeSkype
description:
[ENABLED BY DEFAULT]

Skype for Business GAL (Global Address List) data files will be included in the ODFC Container.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\IncludeSkype
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

name: OdfcIsDynamicVHD
description:
[ENABLED BY DEFAULT]

VHD(x) containers will be dynamically allocated. VHD(x) file size will grow as data is added to the VHD(x). If disabled, VHD(x) containers that are auto-created will be fully allocated.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\IsDynamic
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

name: OdfcIncludeOutlookPersonalization
description:
[ENABLED BY DEFAULT]

Outlook personalization data will be included in the ODFC Container.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\IncludeOutlookPersonalization
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

name: OdfcRemoveOrphanedOSTFilesOnLogoff
displayName: Remove Orphaned OST Files On Logoff
description:
Removes duplicate OST files.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\RemoveOrphanedOSTFilesOnLogoff
Type: DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

name: OdfcReattachInterval
description:
When a VHD(x) volume is detached unexpectedly, the FSLogix system will attempt to reattach the volume. This value specifies the number of seconds to wait between retries. The default value is 10 seconds which is the same as "Not Configured".

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\ReAttachIntervalSeconds
Type:  DWORD
Values:  Min = 1, Max = 60

name: OdfcIncludeOneNote
description:
OneNote local notebook cache will be included in the ODFC Container.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\IncludeOneNote
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

name: OdfcVHDXSectorSize
description:
This setting is only applicable if the virtual disk type is VHDX. The default is the sytem default which is the same as "Not Configured".

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\VHDXSectorSize
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = System Default, 512, 4096

name: OdfcSizeInMBs
description:
Specify the size for auto-created VHD(X) files. The default is 30,000 (30GB) which is the same as "Not Configured".

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\SizeInMBs
Type:  DWORD
Values:  Min = 500, Max = 1000000

name: OdfcIncludeOneNoteUWP
description:
OneNote UWP notebook data will be included in the ODFC Container.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\IncludeOneNote_UWP
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

name: OdfcMirrorLocalOSTToVHD
description:
Sync existing local OST file (if any) to the VHD(x) when a new VHD(x) is created.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\MirrorLocalOSTToVHD
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Do not mirror, 1 = Copy to VHD, 2 = Move to VHD

name: OdfcReattachCount
description:
When a VHD(x) volume is detached unexpectedly, the FSLogix system will attempt to re-attach the volume. This value specifies how many times to retry. The default value is 60 retries which is the same as "Not Configured".

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\ReAttachRetryCount
Type:  DWORD
Values:  Min = 0, Max = 600

name: OdfcVolumeTypeVHDorVHDX
description:
Specifies the type of virtual disk to auto-create. The default is VHD which is the same as "Not Configured".

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\VolumeType
Type:  REG_SZ
Values:  VHD, VHDX

name: OdfcVHDLocations
description:
Specifies the network location where the VHD(X) files are stored.

Examples:
- Sinlge location:  \\<server fqdn>\<share name>
- Multiple locations: \\<server 1 fqdn>\<share name>;\\<server 2 fqdn>\<share name>

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\VHDLocations
REG_SZ

name: OdfcOutlookCachedMode
description:
When the ODFC Container is successfully attached, set Outlook to work in cached mode for the user. The setting change will only be effective for the specific user and for the length of the user session.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\OutlookCachedMode
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled (only if container is attached)

name: OdfcLockedRetryCount
description:
Specifies the number of retries to perform when a VHD(x) file is locked (open by another process or computer). The default value is 12 retries which is the same as "Not Configured".

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\LockedRetryCount
Type:  DWORD
Values:  Min = 0, Max = 600

name: OdfcAccessNetworkasComputer
description:
Attach as computer - folder must have permissions for computer objects.

CAUTION:  Do not use this configuration setting unless your storage provider or architecture will NOT work with user-level permissions to the VHD(x) container locations. This setting will allow the virtual machine to access all the VHD(x) files on the storage provider creating a potential security risk.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\AccessNetworkAsComputerObject
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

name: OdfcRedirectType
description:
Configures legacy or FSLogix advanced redirection. The default is '2' which is the same as "Not Configured".

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\RedirectType
Type:  DWORD
Values:  Legacy = 1, FSLogix Redirection = 2

name: OdfcIncludeSharepoint
description:
[ENABLED BY DEFAULT]

Sharepoint data files will be included in the ODFC Container.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\IncludeSharepoint
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

name: OdfcOutlookFolderPath
description:
Specifies the path to the user's Outlook data folder.

Default value:  %userprofile%\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Outlook

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\OutlookFolderPath
Type:  REG_SZ

options.displayName: Do not mirror OST to VHD

name: OdfcPreventLoginWithFailure
description:
Prevent user login when a failure occurs while attaching an FSLogix container.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\PreventLoginWithFailure
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

name: OdfcRoamSearch
description:
Enable search roaming in legacy Windows Operating Systems.

NOTE: Do not use this setting with Windows Server 2019 (or later) or Windows 10 (or later). Newer operating systems support per-user search.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\RoamSearch
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Single User Search, 2 = Multi-user Search

name: OdfcODFCEnabled
description:
Enables ODFC containers which changes the location of some Office based data.

CAUTION: ODFC containers are designed to work with other roaming profie solutions. It is recommended to only use Profile containers when using FSLogix.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\Enabled
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

name: OdfcRefreshUserPolicy
description:
If a GPO is configured for an Office product that is included in the ODFC container, there may be a conflict with a previous user setting. Standard behavior is for the GPO to be applied, but when the ODFC container is read, the GPO will be over-written by the setting in the  ODFC container. If the desire is for the GPO change to be universally applied, then enabling this setting should be done prior to the GPO update being applied. When this setting is enabled, the ODFC container will overwrite the previous user setting with the GPO setting.

NOTE: There is a performance implication to enabling the RefreshUserPolicy. RefreshUserPolicy should only be enabled during a specific GPO and then should be set back to disabled.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\RefreshUserPolicy
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

name: OdfcIncludeOneDrive
description:
[ENABLED BY DEFAULT]

OneDrive cache will be included in the ODFC Container.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\IncludeOneDrive
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

name: OdfcIncludeOfficeActivation
description:
[ENABLED BY DEFAULT]

Office activation data is redirected to the container.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\IncludeOfficeActivation
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

name: OdfcNumberSessionVHDsToKeep
description:
This setting is used when VHDAccessMode is set to '3'. This controls the number of session VHD(x) containers that are persisted. For example, if this is set to '2' and the user creates a 3rd session, a new session VHD(x) will be created and used and it will be deleted when the 3rd session ends. Th default value is 2 sessions which is the same as "Not Configured"

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\NumSessionVHDsToKeep
Type:  DWORD
Values:  Min = 0, Max = 10

name: OdfcIncludeOutlook
description:
[ENABLED BY DEFAULT]

Outlook data files will be included in the ODFC Container.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\IncludeOutlook
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

name: OdfcIncludeTeams
description:
Teams data files will be included in the ODFC Container.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\IncludeTeams
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled
